category_title: Pupils who 'show off' and struggle with impulse control in peer groups
student_description: David is a student who struggles with impulse control and often shows off or becomes confrontational under peer pressure. While he claims he can control his behavior, he lacks insight into his underlying motivations and often defaults to 'Don't know' when questioned. He uniquely requires collaborative, peer-assisted reflection to uncover these hidden forces, alongside positive, incremental goal-setting and flexible teacher relationships to navigate his unpredictable moods.

criteria.rationale: David struggles to analyze his own behavior independently and benefits from peer perspectives to break through his 'Don't know' barrier.
criteria.check: The tutor's response must invite or leverage peer input to help analyze the situation, rather than relying solely on a one-on-one interrogation.

criteria.rationale: Because David claims he can behave when he wants but lacks insight into why he shows off, he needs help uncovering the hidden forces driving his actions.
criteria.check: The tutor must ask probing questions that explore the underlying reasons or external pressures (e.g., peer influence) behind David's behavior, rather than accepting surface-level answers.
